name: authoring-preview-auto-repair
description: Deterministic in-preview auto-repair: a draft whose JSONata output_transform throws at runtime comes back GREEN from ONE dry_run_workflow call. The repair is verified against the engine's real root (the last step's data) and the declared output_schema, the repaired definition is re-run from step fixtures (zero upstream calls), the draft carries the verified expression, the envelope carries auto_repair + the preview.auto_repaired warning, the audit log records workflow.preview_auto_repaired, and two executions rows exist linked via replaced_execution_id. No second preview, no edit_workflow_patch.

input.goal: Return the hottest day of the forecast: the date and its maximum temperature.
